title: Lusin exhaustion of a finite-measure Borel set by closed continuity sets (Simon Thm 1.1.17 as used in Remark 3.1.8(1))
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Let A ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be a Borel set with Hⁿ(A) < ∞, and let ϑ : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ be Borel measurable. Then there are sets C_i ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} (i ∈ ℕ), each closed, contained in A and with ϑ continuous on C_i (ContinuousOn ϑ C_i), such that Hⁿ(A ∖ ⋃_i C_i) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ϑ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ∞ → Measurable ϑ → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ), (∀ i, IsClosed (C i) ∧ C i ⊆ A ∧ ContinuousOn ϑ (C i)) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (A \ ⋃ i, C i) = 0
